snippet.title: Hangzo Arcade
snippet.description:
There are three playable ninjas to chose from: Hanzo the veteran of the team at the ripe old age of 20, Kotaroh with the vertiginous hair with claws and Kasumi the fast lady ninja. All the characters be essentially interchangeable.

The players takes the fight against the evil business man “Mr. K” onto the city streets. Hanzo uses his sword to cut down the gun emplacement ahead of him. 
As well as using your sword to attack nearby enemies, you can use the other attack button to sling a shuriken for ranged damage. 
You can also hold the shuriken button down,you can charge the shuriken attack to do extra damage with an increase hitbox. 
Holding the button can be also used to keep a shuriken at the ready so you can release it when an enemy hops into your path. When holding the button you cannot move or jump.

There is a jump button, however, if you double-tap it your character produces a rope and proceeds to swing across the screen with their foot extended. A dangerous, deadly foot that can be used to kick enemies to death.

Hangzo offers you the chance to ride these guardian lion. Looks cool and has an ability to fire large projectiles out of their mouths definitely comes in handy, but they have slightly ungainly movements and the vague collision detection.

There are 5 stages with different bosses at the end of each stage, The final stage has a “boss rush” feel to it, like every game of this genre.
